verdicts.reason: A and B look the same; they differ by a pixel or two at most. Both are broken in the same ways. The geometric background is squeezed into a narrow middle strip, leaving bare white on the left and right. The white frame has slid off to the right and sits in empty space, and the pink dots are stranded in the pattern and in the empty area instead of flanking the name. 'THE MINIMALIST' and the opening line are tiny and wedged into one ragged row at the bottom, pushed against the left edge, so the hierarchy and centred symmetry of the original are lost.
